name: sap-notes
description: Search and retrieve SAP Notes and Knowledge Base Articles.
long_description: SAP Notes connects MCP clients to SAP for Me and provides tools to search SAP Notes and Knowledge Base Articles, fetch complete note details, and optionally retrieve correction instructions. It supports username/password, SAP Passport certificate, and shared SSO storage-state authentication.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search SAP Notes and Knowledge Base Articles by keywords.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the complete details and optional correction instructions for an SAP Note.

sap_username.title: SAP Username
sap_username.description: Your SAP for Me login username, usually your email address.

sap_password.title: SAP Password
sap_password.description: Your SAP for Me password, stored securely by the MCP host.

auth_method.title: Authentication Method
auth_method.description: Authentication method: auto, password, or certificate. Auto tries configured credentials in the supported order.

sap_login_url.title: SAP Login URL
sap_login_url.description: SAP for Me login page used to establish an authenticated session.

mfa_timeout.title: MFA Timeout
mfa_timeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for manual multi-factor authentication.

max_jwt_age_h.title: Session Cache Lifetime
max_jwt_age_h.description: Maximum age in hours for a cached SAP session before re-authentication.

headful.title: Show Authentication Browser
headful.description: Show the browser window during authentication; useful for manual MFA and troubleshooting.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

sap_sso_storage_state.title: Shared SAP SSO Storage State
sap_sso_storage_state.description: Path to a Playwright storage-state JSON file used to share an existing SAP SSO session.

pfx_path.title: SAP Passport Certificate
pfx_path.description: Optional path to an SAP Passport certificate in PFX format for certificate authentication.

pfx_passphrase.title: Certificate Passphrase
pfx_passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for the SAP Passport certificate, stored securely by the MCP host.

sap_notes_token_cache_file.title: Token Cache File
sap_notes_token_cache_file.description: Path used to persist the cached SAP Notes session tokens.

playwright_browser_type.title: Playwright Browser Type
playwright_browser_type.description: Optional Playwright browser engine override: chromium, firefox, or webkit.

env_file.title: Environment File
env_file.description: Optional path to an additional dotenv file loaded before the server starts.
